COURT'S OR JUDGES'S ORDERS
WPSS No.1468 of 2022
Hon 'b le Man oj Ku m ar Tiw ar i, J.

Mr. Piyush Garg, Advocate for the
petitioner.
Mr. V.S. Rawat, Brief Holder for the
State of Uttarakhand.
Heard learned counsel for the
parties.
Petitioner is serving as Assistant
Teacher (Commerce) in a Government
I nter College. He was transferred from
Government I nter College,
Narayanbagad, District Cham oli to
Government I nter College Rani Chauri,
District Tehri Garhwal vide order dated
11.07.2022.
According to the petitioner, he
joined at the transferred place on
22.07.2022, however, his transfer was
subsequently cancelled vide order dated
23.07.2022. The reason assigned for
cancelling petitioner's transfer is that
petitioner was wrongly transferred to
Rani Chauri based on the services
rendered by his wife in Durgam Schools.

I t is not in dispute that petitioner's
wife is serving as Assistant Teacher in a
Government Prim ary School in District
Tehri Garhwal. Petitioner has challenged
the cancellation order dated 23.07.2022.
I t is contended by learned counsel
for the petitioner that petitioner had
rendered 27 years and 10 m onths
service in Governm ent I nter College Rani
Chauri, which was Durgam School at the
relevant point of tim e, however, those
services are now being treated as having
been rendered in a Sugam area, based
on a revised categorization of school,
which led to cancellation of petitioner's
transfer.
Learned counsel for the petitioner
submits that petitioner had challenged
the wrong categorization of the aforesaid
school by filing a writ petition and this
Court had perm itted the petitioner to
m ake representation against such wrong
categorization, however, due to his
transfer, he could not m ake such
representation.
Learned counsel for the petitioner
confines his prayer and submits that
petitioner m ay be permitted to m ake

representation against cancellation of his
transfer and also for wrong
categorization of the aforesaid school.
Learned Brief Holder submits that if
petitioner m akes such representation,
decision thereupon shall be taken at the
earliest.
Accordingly, the writ petition is
disposed of with liberty to petitioner to
m ake representation to Regional
Additional Director on or before
01.08.2022. I f petitioner m akes such
representation within the stipulated
period, decision thereupon shall be
taken, within two weeks thereafter. I t
shall be open to petitioner to submit
representation through e-m ail with soft
copy of this order.
For a period of three weeks' or till
decision on petitioner's representation,
whichever is earlier, petitioner shall not
be relieved from Government I nter
College, Rani Chauri, District Tehri
Garhwal.

( Man oj Ku m ar Tiw ar i, J.)
 28.07.2022
Arpan
